epic.name: Dashboard sent email count & log detail layout improvements
epic.description: Consolidated improvements to accurately query and display sent emails on the dashboard pay-as-you-go card and enhance LogDetailSheet date formatting and stats card layout.
epic.notes: Includes backend query optimization in WalletUseCase and frontend layout adjustments in LogDetailSheet and DashboardContent.

tasks.name: 1. Query actual sent emails in WalletUseCase
tasks.description: Counts records directly from EmailTable for non-test emails to calculate totalEmailsSent accurately instead of approximating from wallet deductions.
acceptanceCriteria: EmailTable is queried directly using count() filter for organizationId and isTestEmail = false.
totalEmailsSent accurately reflects the count of sent emails.

subtasks.name: 1. Replace wallet deduction calculation with direct EmailTable count query
subtasks.description: Modifies getSummary in wallet.use-case.ts to use allTimeEmailStats count.

tasks.name: 2. Display total sent count in Dashboard pay-as-you-go card
tasks.description: Updates DashboardContent to format and show totalSent correctly in the email counter card.
acceptanceCriteria: Total email sent displays formatted totalSent number.

tasks.name: 3. Refine LogDetailSheet timestamp formatting and card widths
tasks.description: Shortens timestamp format from full month to abbreviated 'MMM d, yyyy • h:mm:ss a' and adjusts max width classes on stats cards to prevent overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Timestamp renders with abbreviated month name.
Stats cards maintain responsive max widths without layout breakage.

dailyNotes.text: Dashboard sent email count & log detail layout improvements
